mapper.update: UPDATE book SET status='READY', active_artifact_id=#{artifactId,jdbcType=BINARY,typeHandler=com.readict.shared.persistence.typehandler.UuidBinaryTypeHandler}, last_read_at=#{now,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP,typeHandler=com.readict.shared.persistence.typehandler.UtcInstantTypeHandler}, updated_at=#{now,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP,typeHandler=com.readict.shared.persistence.typehandler.UtcInstantTypeHandler} WHERE id=#{id,jdbcType=BINARY,typeHandler=com.readict.shared.persistence.typehandler.UuidBinaryTypeHandler} AND status='IMPORTING'

UPDATE book SET status='FAILED', updated_at=#{now,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP,typeHandler=com.readict.shared.persistence.typehandler.UtcInstantTypeHandler} WHERE id=#{id,jdbcType=BINARY,typeHandler=com.readict.shared.persistence.typehandler.UuidBinaryTypeHandler} AND status='IMPORTING'

UPDATE book b SET b.status='FAILED', b.updated_at=#{now,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP,typeHandler=com.readict.shared.persistence.typehandler.UtcInstantTypeHandler} WHERE b.status='IMPORTING' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM import_task t WHERE t.book_id=b.id AND t.state IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING'))
